passives.name: The Information Age
passives.description: (Passive Effect) At the start of battle, grants an irremovable reduced damage taken to all allies for [Buff_T_tower_very_hard_common_dmg_reduce_single] turn(s). When an ally uses a single-target skill, increases Priority of all allies except for that ally by [Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000041_4_2], and has a [Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000041_4_1] chance to grant an extra turn. Every turn, increases Attack of the caster by [Buff_V_tower_very_hard_common_atkup]. (Max 20 stacks)
